run_evaluation_from_checkpoint: run evaluation on a trained COPE model using a saved checkpoint file path
run_evaluation_with_train_args: run evaluation by passing training arguments directly without a checkpoint file
run_evaluation_override_defaults: run evaluation from a checkpoint while overriding default config values via CLI args
review_eval_entry_point: review the eval.py entry point that loads checkpoints and calls the eval function
summarize_eval_workflow: summarize the evaluation workflow that parses args, loads config, and runs model evaluation
